notes.title: Update # 4 (v 0.3.0)
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New game mode: Practice Mode. Player can select any bowl type, speed and position of the pitch for bowling.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] In main menu UI, added button highlight whenever the laser pointer from bat hits the button.
[*] Fixed a bug in steamworks integration.
[*] Leaderboards will not copy values from other leaderboards for display.
[*] Adjusted and improved left-handed bowling presets.
[/list]

notes.title: Update # 3 (v 0.2.2)
notes.content:
This updates has following:

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements have been added.
[*] During gameplay red ring around the ball will be displayed when ball is hit with bat to help the player keep track of the ball.
[*] In survival mode, fielding settings will be automatically changed according the runs the player has made.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon fielding switch while changing the batting hand style, wrong fielders tend to chase the ball. Its fixed now.
[*] In main menu UI, texts have been given shadow for clearer view.
[*] Minor tweaks have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Update # 2 (v 0.2.1)
notes.content:
This update addresses few issues.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated collision physics
[*] Fixed UI issues
[*] Instead of displaying 'Out!', two different texts will be displayed. 'Bowled' if ball hits the wickets. 'Catch Out' if fielder or wicket keeper catches the ball in the air.
[*] After finishing a match, the six distance still retained the value of previous six in previous match. Its been fixed to reset to '0'.
[/list]

notes.title: Update # 1 (v 0.2)
notes.content:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New game mode: Survival Mode. You only have one wicket, see how long you can survive without getting out. Separate leaderboard has been setup for survival mode.
[*] Bowling variations have been added: Spin (Off-spin/Leg-spin) and Swing (In-swing/Out-swing).
[*] Improved and updated bat/ball collision physics.
[*] Stadium is visually improved. Added fences, stadium enclosures and live feed screen. 
[*] Environment lights updated.
[*] Live camera screen. This screen shows score along with keeping track on the ball.
[*] In ‘Options’ menu, height adjustment feature has been added for players. Now each player can adjust the headset height accordingly.
[*] Added wide ball detection.
[/list]

[h1]Major Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] At start of an over, the type of bowling will be indicated.
[*] During bowling countdown the icon will appear on top right of white screen indicating the ability to pause the game during countdown.
[*] Game title is shown before main menu.
[*] Removed extra bat on the ground.
[/list]
